description: Wait for a Stripe link from choose-plan or add-payment-method (up to ~45 seconds per call; call again while it reports open). For a choose-plan link it reports when the plan has switched; for add-payment-method, when the card is saved, then switches plan if one was named.

organisation_id.description: The organization ID; needed with session_id for a link from an earlier session

session_id.description: The session_id choose-plan or add-payment-method printed; defaults to the latest link from this server

name: payment-method-status
